name: Dash (Action)
desc: Taking the Dash action gains you extra movement for the current turn equal to your speed, after any modifiers are applied. For example, a speed of 30 feet lets you move up to 60 feet on a turn where you Dash. Any increase or decrease to your speed changes this additional movement by the same amount.
